name: Kettlebell Outside Pendulum Swing
description: A single-arm swing where the bell travels on an outside, pendulum-like arc — out and around the working-side hip rather than straight between the legs. Driven by the legs and hips ('leg drivers'), not the arm: hinge, load, and snap the hips to send the bell up and out, letting it float at the top before it pendulums back. The offset lateral path adds an anti-rotation and frontal-plane demand on top of the standard hinge. Keep the core braced so the torso doesn't twist toward the bell.
